const cmds = [

files=(\"mod-tome.lua\",\"tome-orcs.lua\")

    old=subprocess.run([\"git\",\"show\",\"d11abfc3242aa9fd497e95f5e66d10db7dc137c6:\"+name],cwd=root,check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout
    before=loader.load_bytes(old,logical_path=name).records
    after=loader.load_path(root/name,logical_path=name).records
    assert len(before)==len(after),(name,len(before),len(after))
    for index,(left,right) in enumerate(zip(before,after),start=1):
        keys=set(left)|set(right)
        changed={key:(left.get(key),right.get(key)) for key in keys if left.get(key)!=right.get(key) and key not in {\"line\"}}
        if changed:
            assert set(changed)=={\"target\"},(name,index,changed)
            all_changes.append((name,index,left.get(\"source\"),left.get(\"source_tag\"),changed[\"target\"]))
assert len(all_changes)==2,all_changes

assert {entry[2] for entry in all_changes}==expected
print(\"PASS: LuaJIT loaded both files; exactly 2 translation records changed; only target fields differ\")
